eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Platform] ZeebeBannedInstances
eventTemplate.description:
Zeebe has banned a process instance due to a processing error, in namespace {dims}. Immediate investigation required.

Source rule ORs zeebe_banned_instances_total with the legacy zeebe_blacklisted_instances_total, and datadog_alerts/ mirrors that as three files (two components + a composite) because Datadog can't OR two distinct metric queries in one monitor. That legacy metric is pre-Micrometer and does not exist in Camunda 8.7's native OTLP push (see metric-mapping-8.7.md), so this is a single alert on zeebe.banned.instances.total only.

Runbook: https://github.com/camunda/runbook/blob/main/zeebe/troubleshooting-guide.md
